content.rendered:
The Lodge & Casa Palmero the Spa, 19th Hole at Pebble Beach.

July 31st Anniversary DJ jamie bush pebble beach

First Dance –
“By Your Side.” Jen and I will start the dance and then everyone should be invited to join us. It should be announced as the first dance of the bride and groom 10-years ago.

Kids dance with parents. Invite them up. – hokey pokey

After cake:
Father Daughter song
Martina McBride – In My Daughter’s eyes
where all three couple dance (Jen with her dad, me with Jen’s mom, and Tom and Donna — my parents

11PM/11:30PM
End of the night
Mother/Son
Josh Groban – You Raise Me Up
mother/son dance where again we dance with our parents (me and my mom, Jen and my dad, and then Ed and Nancy — Jen’s parents).

The Lodge Pebble Beach DJ


The 19th Hole Monterey
